name: arcade
statement: Games are cards: a game's tables, rules and logic compile into a native module that the store builds, serves and launches; a console player is the machine cards plus a card-language player, built the same way; every item the store lists installs, verifies, repairs and runs through the store's own protocol (the self-run's store step).
usefulness: Games made from the model's cards, and the user's own cartridges, ship through Cardmodel Arcade.
